GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Ridden Along back 3rd last 5 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden from the corner and was Just one paced in Straight # one paced

jumped awkwardly . Pushed to recover & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead) early . Out Two Wide & Held Ground midrace until pushed out 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & ground to line @ one pace in last 150m. # Fair effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 600m. Pushed along 3 Wide @ 500m & laid out Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & gave ground in last 200m. # Never a chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare, App rdr advised that after being slow to begin, her mount settled further back than anticipated and thereafter did not travel at any stage and may not have appreciated today's soft (7) track conditions. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to have an elevated heart rate and slow recovery.
